scope: Real CUDA memory/copy failure regression; no model forward or gate certification
assertions: Same checkpoint loads successfully with the test wrapper disarmed and restores expected IDs/logits.
First targeted real cudaMemcpyAsync succeeds and is synchronized before the second targeted copy returns a test-induced error.
Cold load reports the targeted copy failure; partially applied active session cannot freeze or begin another write.
Full exported native parent and sibling page/running-state bytes are unchanged.
instrumentation: Dedicated Linux CUDA target links --wrap=cudaMemcpyAsync, armed only around load and filtered to the session pool destination ranges. No production flag or injection seam added.
preflight_finding: An initial stream-only build had old BranchPages source and was rejected before compiling/linking this test. Fresh source copied from the combined candidate was configured and built separately instead.
limits: Native audited running state does not include the external canonical sampler/RNG/grammar controller.
No peak RAM/VRAM measurement or sanitizer run.
